# Portal Home AudienceDoors clips command chips on phone viewports

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for immediate Engine 14 pre-cut delivery (`2026-11-23`), promoting `@neo-opus-ada`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:25f0f1a6-b1f9-4c28-a757-d76db1c526b7`); curated contributor labels omitted because the Engine 14 front-door lock is within hours.

## Context

On `dev` (`3f01b65ae4`), Screen 2 of the Portal Home (`Portal.view.home.parts.AudienceDoors`, `#/home`) clips its `.portal-door-command` code chips at phone viewports instead of fitting or wrapping cleanly inside the card:

| Viewport | Door 1 (`$ npx neo-app@latest`) | Door 2 (`neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institution`) | Door 3 (`MX · Two Hemispheres · Gated RSI`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `390 × 844` | `303 / 303 px` | **`342 px` inside `303 px`** (`39 px` clipped: `"neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institut…"`) | `303 / 303 px` |
| `360 × 800` | `273 / 273 px` | **`342 px` inside `273 px`** (`69 px` clipped) | **`285 px` inside `273 px`** (`12 px` clipped) |

## The Problem

`resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/AudienceDoors.css:127` sets `.portal-door-command code { white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.85rem; }`. The intermediate compact-desktop/tablet rule (`@media (min-width: 841px) and (max-height: 820px), (min-width: 841px) and (max-width: 1100px)`, lines `207-211`) overrides `code` with `white-space: normal; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.35;`, **but the phone rule `@media (max-width: 840px)` (lines `227-249`) omits any `.portal-door-command code` override**. Because `.portal-door-command` has `overflow-x: auto`, `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:353` (`#${home.id}` `scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1`) stayed green while the chip itself overflowed and clipped at the card edge.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/AudienceDoors.css:108-129,203-212,227-249` — styles `.portal-door-command` and its responsive breakpoints.
- `apps/portal/view/home/parts/AudienceDoors.mjs:130-136,187-193,241-247` — renders the three `.portal-door-command > code` chips.
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:333-366` — mobile `390 × 844` stacking and overflow assertions (runs in CI `e2e-engine`).
- Design authority: `resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/AudienceDoors.css:207-211` (`white-space: normal; line-height: 1.35;` already established for narrow desktop/tablet cards in `#20971`) and Epic `#20682` / `#20971` AC-5 (wrapped mobile cards never clip content).

## The Fix

*(Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/AudienceDoors.css` and `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` — own the concern.)*

1. In `resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/AudienceDoors.css` inside `@media (max-width: 840px) .portal-glass-card`:
   - Add `.portal-door-command { padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem; code { font-size: clamp(0.66rem, 3vw, 0.75rem); line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: normal; } }` so all three chips sit on one crisp line at `390 × 844` and `360 × 800` and wrap cleanly under browser zoom without clipping.
   - Rebuild theme CSS via `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`.
2. In `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs`:
   - Assert every `.portal-door-command` chip satisfies `scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1` at `390 × 844` and `360 × 800` (recorded red on `dev` and green at head).

## Decision Record impact

`none` (CSS sizing/wrapping only; zero copy changes to `AudienceDoors.mjs` or `ADR 0018` text).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: At `390 × 844` and `360 × 800` on `#/home`, all three `.portal-door-command` chips in `Portal.view.home.parts.AudienceDoors` render whole (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1`) with zero horizontal card or page overflow while `1440 × 900` and `900 × 700` layout geometry remains intact.
- [ ] AC-2: `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` records a red failure on `dev` (`3f01b65ae4`) for `.portal-door-command` mobile overflow and passes green at head alongside `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`.
- [ ] AC-3: Before (`dev`) and after (`head`) `390 × 844` and `360 × 800` `#/home` AudienceDoors frames are attached on the PR with `Frame critique:`.

## Out of Scope

- Screen 1 `HeroContainer` / `RoundTable` layout and copy (`#21586`, `#20987`).
- Portal Examples catalog `.portal-example-feature` caption lengths at `1366 × 768` (`grid.json`, `charts.json` — separate surface).

## Avoided Traps

- Editing the chip text in `AudienceDoors.mjs` (`neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institution` and `MX · Two Hemispheres · Gated RSI` are canonical organism anchors asserted in `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:163-167,461-463`).
- Checking only `#${home.id}` container `scrollWidth` while `.portal-door-command` keeps `overflow-x: auto`, which masks internal chip clipping.
